sources.title: GitHub - anthropics/jacobian-lens: Companion code for the global ...
sources.snippet: The Jacobian lens reads out what an internal activation is disposed to make the model say. It linearly transports a residual-stream vector at any layer and position into the final-layer basis, then decodes it with the model's own unembedding into a ranked list of vocabulary tokens.

sources.title: Jacobian lens for DeepSeek-V4-Flash (preview) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The band, corpus (same WikiText-103 stream, first 100 records ≥600 chars, 128 tokens), skip_first=16, per-prompt normalization, and dim_batch are all identical to the 0731 n=100 lens, so any preview-vs-0731 lens difference is attributable to the post-training change rather than to fitting settings.

sources.title: neuronpedia/jacobian-lens · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This folder contains pre-fitted Jacobian Lenses for specific models. They were trained using Anthropic's Jacobian Lens library. The same library can be used to load the lens and local visualizer.

sources.title: Applying the Lens (`JacobianLens`) | anthropics/jacobian-lens | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Logit-Lens Baseline: Optional "vanilla" logit-lens mode where activations are passed directly to the unembedding layer without Jacobian transformation. Model Integration: Execution of forward passes on a LensModel while capturing internal states via ActivationRecorder.
